name: War Pig raises Physical damage dealt by 4% (#1074)
contract: War Pig 705020 reads 'Increases your Physical damage dealt by 4%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z). Effect 0 is the native aura 79 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE), MiscValue 1 (SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL), BasePoints 4. Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone (used by the spell-damage path) folds this in directly; Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone's simplified normal-school path instead relies on UpdateDamagePctDoneMods already having applied it to UNIT_FIELD_MINDAMAGE/MAXDAMAGE, so weapon_damage_min is used here rather than melee_damage_done, which is structurally blind to this aura for the normal school. At level 60 the owned Sever rank is 501505 (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h).
